messages:
liz (support): FYI customer Gamma (gamma-search) reporting embeddings throughput drop since ~05:00 UTC. tokens/sec looks normal but vectors/sec ~20% of baseline. also seeing intermittent "dimension mismatch" 400s and some 429s. repro steps + logs below.

anika (eng): thanks, can you paste a sample request and model variant? also any recent rollout around 04:30-05:00?

liz (support): sample request attached. model: redwood-embed-512-v2. customer says they didn’t change client code. rollout note: we pushed batching tweak yesterday 04:50 UTC (batch_window_ms reduced).

josh (ml): noted. quick hypothesis: client-side batching mixing different input types -> variable embedding dims, server doing best-effort but then downstream pooling fails and we fallback to slower path. can you grab server logs for request_id=gamma-req-9f7?

liz (support): logs snip (redacted):
```
[05:07:12] req=gamma-req-9f7 POST /v1/embeddings model=redwood-embed-512-v2 size=32 status=200 vecs=32 tokens=480 time_ms=230
[05:07:14] req=gamma-req-9f7 ERROR dimension mismatch expected=512 got=1536 path=/vecize/batch-merge
[05:07:14] req=gamma-req-9f7 WARN fallback to per-item processing, queue_wait_ms=120
[05:07:18] req=gamma-req-c2a POST /v1/embeddings model=redwood-embed-512-v2 size=64 status=429 reason=queue_depth_limit
[05:07:40] gpu=gpu-7 queue_depth=24 backlog_ms=980 avg_latency_ms=420
```

anika (eng): that dimension mismatch log is key. either client is sending mixed-dim payloads in one batch or a model variant got swapped during routing. liz can you confirm if any routing fallback events occurred for gamma-req-9f7?

liz (support): routing logs: no explicit fallback for that request_id, but there are several "compatible-variant-fallback" entries for the customer around 05:05-05:12.

kevin (infra): infra alert: autoscaler delayed because project gamma is at soft quota for dedicated GPUs. autoscaler-bot shows no new instances started between 04:55-05:10.

autoscaler-bot: action=scale_check project=gamma result=quota_blocked current_nodes=6 requested_nodes=9 time=05:02:13

josh (ml): that aligns — reduced pool + smaller batch_window -> higher queueing pressure -> longer KV cache hold times -> more chance of mixing partial state when we try to assemble batches. also the 429s point at queue depth limit being hit.

maria (support): customer reports they see client retries that might re-submit partially-constructed batches after a timeout. could be their SDK combining payloads by size not by dim. asking them for SDK version.

liz (support): asked customer for SDK version and a raw POST body sample. customer returned this example:
```
{"inputs": [["text1"],["text2"],...], "model":"redwood-embed-512-v2", "batching": {"max_batch_size": 64}}
```
They say they rely on our client lib v0.9.1 automatic batching.

anika (eng): can you grep the request traces for header x-embed-dim or any client-supplied metadata? also check if a fallback model redwood-embed-1536-compat was used intermittently.

kevin (infra): quick metrics dump (minute granularity around incident):
```
05:00: gpu-7 queue_depth=6 avg_latency=120ms
05:05: gpu-7 queue_depth=22 avg_latency=410ms
05:10: gpu-7 queue_depth=18 avg_latency=385ms
pool.available=1 -> 0 between 04:56-05:02
```
Looks like pool starved during scale attempt.

anika (eng): mitigation plan: 1) ask customer to force single-dim payloads (verify SDK v0.9.1 behavior), 2) temporarily route gamma to fallback pool with smaller model variant (less KV pressure), 3) rollback batch_window_ms tweak for the rollout id batch-window-2026-03-17 if autoscaler blocked.

josh (ml): also add server-side validation to early-reject mixed-dim batches with a 4xx before heavy KV ops. short-term patch we can push to validate dims pre-merge.

liz (support): providing customer with repro steps to validate client side: run this curl and confirm dims for each item: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-512-v2","inputs":["hello","world"]}'
```
If they ever see mismatched dims in a single request please attach the raw body.

kevin (infra): temporary routing change applied: routing rule gamma -> pool-fallback-3 (smaller instances) — TTL 30m. also requested manual scale quota increase for gamma.

autoscaler-bot: scale_request project=gamma requested=3 status=pending_admin_approval

maria (support): told customer to set client max_concurrency=4 as a stopgap to reduce partial retries. they acknowledged and are testing.

anika (eng): I'll open an incident and assign to eng-runtime to review rollout batch-window-2026-03-17 and the dim-validation patch. creating ticket RN-INC-20260317-01.

josh (ml): quick experiment idea: if we force batcher to group by detected dim header before merging, that should eliminate these mixed-dim merges entirely. low-risk patch.

liz (support): customer testing with max_concurrency=4 now, reporting preliminary vectors/sec improvement (~85% of baseline) after routing to fallback pool. will monitor. thanks all. :thumbsup:

anika (eng): great, please keep trace ids and any failing request bodies that show mixed dims. we’ll follow up with rollback plan status in RN-INC-20260317-01. :eyes:

liz (support): noted, will paste any failing raw bodies here. closing loop when customer confirms stable for 1h.
